_doc: OT alert handler (the SoC's alert collector).  irq declared explicitly (4 class interrupts, standard layout).  alert_in: 65 differential alert-source pairs (alert_tx_i_K__alert_p/n after struct explosion) exposed as OT_DEVICE_ALERT named gpio-ins so existing per-device SoC alert wiring lands unchanged.  Escalation outputs + ping timer semantics: later phase.
